title: Jorjani's dinner with Jacques Vallée on time travel

tellings.quote: He had invited me to his home and we had a nice dinner and and a fairly intimate conversation and I brought this question up with him

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, says that around 2016 or 2017 the well-known UFO researcher Jacques Vallée invited him to his home for dinner. Jorjani says that over a fairly private conversation he raised the question of time travel with Vallée. He told the story on a podcast with host Jesse Michels in 2025, as a sign that serious researchers take the idea seriously.
